rootCause: Origin preparation was coupled to PhoneSender.run and missing from the successful-download/startup backlog path; no visible Library preparation screen.
changes: Default-on persistent local WorkManager queue after each downloader finishes and on application startup; no R2/auto-send requirement.
Library and series menu controls plus an action from the automation preparation gate.
Origin-only processing; receiver copies wait for the origin.
Retained originals and recovery journal; atomic completion receipt and output-file/size checks.
Resume interrupted installs even when raw pages already moved to backup; keep Library refresh from classifying the in-progress install as deleted files.
Protect retained managed task chapters and existing crop/review work; preparation excludes provider starts and managed command acceptance.
Publish process receipt after changed local batches, with no new cloud polling loop.
Reject unsafe or incomplete recovery journals before restoring files; disabling automatic mode stops subsequent automatic chapters after the current install completes.
limits: JVM tests exercise planning, admission and real-filesystem receipt/recovery policy. Android bitmap transformation, WorkManager lifecycle and screen rendering require the updated GitHub Actions APK on the Nord.
